"""Intent tests for mdata.align_calendar: one calendar, forward fill, gap limit (DATA-03, DATA-04)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from mdata import GapError, Prices, RawRow
from mdata.calendar import align_calendar


def _rows(payload: dict) -> list[RawRow]:
    return [RawRow(date=date, ticker=ticker, close=close) for date, ticker, close in payload["rows"]]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_one_calendar_with_filled_gaps(golden):
    """TC-02: four dates from C's first; B's gaps take its previous close. Tolerance: exact."""
    payload, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-02")

    prices = align_calendar(_rows(payload), max_gap=payload["max_gap"])

    assert isinstance(prices, Prices)
    assert prices.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
    assert prices.tickers == tuple(expected["tickers"])
    assert set(prices.closes) == set(expected["closes"])
    for ticker, series in expected["closes"].items():
        assert prices.closes[ticker] == tuple(series)


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_default_max_gap_is_five(golden):
    """The default max_gap (5) fills TC-02's two-date gap the same as passing it explicitly."""
    payload, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-02")

    prices = align_calendar(_rows(payload))

    assert prices.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
    assert prices.closes["B"] == tuple(expected["closes"]["B"])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_six_date_gap_raises_gap_error_naming_ticker(golden):
    """TC-03: B missing six dates in a row is a GapError naming B. Tolerance: exact."""
    payload, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-03")
    assert expected["raises"] == "GapError"

    with pytest.raises(GapError, match=expected["match"]):
        align_calendar(_rows(payload), max_gap=payload["max_gap"])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_six_date_gap_raises_with_default_max_gap(golden):
    """DATA-04: more than 5 dates missing in a row is an error under the default limit."""
    payload, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-03")

    with pytest.raises(GapError, match=expected["match"]):
        align_calendar(_rows(payload))


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_max_gap_is_honoured_below_the_default(golden):
    """B misses two dates in a row in TC-02; with max_gap=1 that is more than allowed."""
    payload, _ = golden("mdata", "TC-02")

    with pytest.raises(GapError, match="B"):
        align_calendar(_rows(payload), max_gap=1)


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_gap_of_exactly_max_gap_is_filled_not_an_error(golden):
    """TC-03 input with max_gap=6: a gap equal to the limit is filled from the previous close."""
    payload, _ = golden("mdata", "TC-03")
    rows = _rows(payload)

    prices = align_calendar(rows, max_gap=6)

    b_closes = {row.date: row.close for row in rows if row.ticker == "B"}
    all_dates = sorted({row.date for row in rows})
    assert prices.dates == tuple(all_dates)
    first_b = b_closes[all_dates[0]]
    for date, close in zip(prices.dates, prices.closes["B"], strict=True):
        assert close == b_closes.get(date, first_b)
